spec.title: Datacenter
spec.description: The racks the twin runs, with their hosts. Add one with +, picking a rack prefab; edit one with its pencil: a rack, CPU, or GPU picked from its list brings its numbers. The twin runs a change from its next window.

spec.title: Hosts available vs. in use
spec.description: The gap between the two lines is underutilized compute infrastructure, which still consumes electricity while idle.

spec.title: Rack prefabs
spec.description: Kinds of hosts: a CPU, memory, and GPUs per host, and how many hosts a rack brings to the datacenter (277, as SURF-SARA, to compare like with like). Edit, add (+), or delete them; your changes are kept across runs.

spec.title: CPU prefabs
spec.description: CPUs to build racks from, with the idle and maximum power of their server. Edit, add (+), or delete them; your changes are kept across runs.

spec.title: GPU prefabs
spec.description: GPUs to build racks from, with their idle and maximum power. Edit, add (+), or delete them; your changes are kept across runs.
